verdict.rationale: The only onboarding-related evidence is that platforms must integrate Mangopay's hosted KYC/KYB for all user types, plus a generic line about managing users in full compliance. Nothing shows tunable or progressive onboarding, such as collecting minimal data to start selling and deferring the rest until payout thresholds. Nothing shows per-seller requirements-due states either, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.
